title: Wash and reuse sheet

scenes.video_prompt: Vertical video, handheld smartphone footage on an Indian RCC construction site. An Indian construction worker holding a water hose pipe sprays water onto a plain light-grey plastic shuttering sheet lying on the ground. Wet concrete slurry washes off instantly, revealing a clean, smooth light-grey face. The sheet is 8 x 4 ft, 12 mm thick, plain light-grey with small round hollow core holes visible on the edge, no text, no logos, natural daylight.

An Indian mistri effortlessly picks up a single clean, washed light-grey 8x4 ft plastic shuttering sheet and stacks it neatly onto a pile of identical grey sheets.
